items.title: For a finite pseudo-coherent morphism the right adjoint of pushforward is the internal Hom out of the pushed forward structure sheaf

items.difficulty_reason: For a finite pseudo-coherent morphism f : Y -> X of schemes, the lemma asserts that RSheafHom(f_*O_Y, -) maps D^+_QCoh(O_X) into D^+_QCoh(f_*O_Y), and that for quasi-compact and quasi-separated X the diagram comparing the right adjoint a of pushforward with the equivalence Phi of Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-affine-morphism-equivalence commutes (statement lines 2762-2799). The parenthetical that a finite morphism of Noetherian schemes is pseudo-coherent is More on Morphisms, Lemma labelled more-morphisms-lemma-Noetherian-pseudo-coherent (proof lines 2801-2805). Since f is pseudo-coherent, f_*O_Y is a pseudo-coherent O_X-module by More on Morphisms, Lemma labelled more-morphisms-lemma-finite-pseudo-coherent, so RSheafHom(f_*O_Y, -) maps D^+_QCoh(O_X) into D^+_QCoh(f_*O_Y) by Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-quasi-coherence-internal-hom (proof lines 2805-2813). The claim then follows because Phi o a and RSheafHom(f_*O_Y, -) are both right adjoint to the restriction functor D^+_QCoh(f_*O_Y) -> D^+_QCoh(O_X), using Lemmas labelled lemma-twisted-inverse-image-bounded-below and lemma-sheafhom-affine-adjoint (proof lines 2813-2819). Identifying both functors as right adjoints of the same restriction functor is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
